positive.sql:
SELECT address,
       ROUND(MAX(age) - CAST(MIN(age) AS numeric) / MAX(age), 2) AS formula,
       ROUND(AVG(age), 2) AS average,
       (MAX(age) - CAST(MIN(age) AS numeric) / MAX(age)) > AVG(age) AS comparison
FROM person
GROUP BY address
ORDER BY address;

SELECT address, ROUND(MAX(age) - MIN(age)::numeric / MAX(age), 2) AS formula, ROUND(AVG(age), 2) AS average, ROUND(MAX(age) - MIN(age)::numeric / MAX(age), 2) > ROUND(AVG(age), 2) AS comparison FROM person GROUP BY address ORDER BY address;
